SELECT internal_id AS internalId, id, area_nm AS name, area_desc AS description, raw_address AS address, area_se AS type, latitude, longitude,
ST_Distance(location, ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat})::geography) AS distanceMeter,
0 AS distanceMeter,
fclty_knd AS imageUrl, status FROM smoking_areas
status != 'CLOSED'
AND (area_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR raw_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND area_se = #{type}
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY
distanceMeter ASC,
internal_id DESC

SELECT id, latitude, longitude, area_se AS areaType FROM smoking_areas WHERE status = 'VERIFIED'
AND location && ST_MakeEnvelope(#{swLng}, #{swLat}, #{neLng}, #{neLat}, 4326)
